lean.statement:
(μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {η C : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hC : 0 < C) :
    let R := fun y : E => μ.tilted (fun x => -‖x-y‖^2/(2*η))
    let U := fun y : E => -Real.log (C*∫ x, Real.exp (-‖y-x‖^2/(2*η)) ∂μ)
    (∀ y, IsProbabilityMeasure (R y) ∧ MemLp (fun x : E => x) 2 (R y)) ∧
    (∀ y v, fderiv ℝ U y v = inner ℝ (y-∫ x, x ∂(R y)) v/η) ∧
    ∀ y v w, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ U) y v w =
      inner ℝ v w/η - covarianceBilin (R y) v w/η^2
approved_definition_context: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with Borel measurable space, including dimension zero. mu is a probability measure; eta and C are positive real numbers. C is a constant and need not be the Gaussian density prefactor.

Measure.tilted(f) is the actual exponential tilt with density exp(f)/integral exp(f) against its base law. A real integral is the Bochner integral. MemLp(id,2,R) means finite second moment plus measurability under the actual measure R.

fderiv R is the Frechet derivative as a continuous linear map; nested fderiv is its bilinear second derivative. inner R is the real inner product. covarianceBilin(R)(v,w) is the centered covariance of the scalar projections inner(v,X) and inner(w,X) when the identity is L2. Real.exp/log are real exponential/logarithm. All let expressions define actual measures/functions, without supplied derivative or moment identities.
